original_ai_prompt: Run DHCP from a Windows server for the whole office, and put the office VLAN on 192.168.50.0/24 — that exact subnet, please.
cleaned_prompt: Run DHCP from a Windows server for the whole office, and put the office VLAN on 192.168.50.0/24 — that exact subnet, please.
expected_behaviour: TWO named refusals: (1) server-side DHCP is 'server-dhcp-service' (unsupported; use gateway pools); (2) a user-fixed CIDR outside the engine's per-site 10.N.0.0/16 block triggers 'vlan-outside-site-block' at expansion. The model must surface both real constraints rather than fake them.
capability_limitations: TWO named refusals: (1) server-side DHCP is 'server-dhcp-service' (unsupported; use gateway pools); (2) a user-fixed CIDR outside the engine's per-site 10.N.0.0/16 block triggers 'vlan-outside-site-block' at expansion. The model must surface both real constraints rather than fake them.
why_suitable: Combines the DHCP-service limit with the fixed-CIDR site-block limit — two independent real constraints that a careless model would silently 'make work'.
